title: gtm cs 1:1 prep - acmecorp renewal + se follow-ups
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Alex Morris (AE) + quick sync with SE on AcmeCorp
Date: 2026-03-05 (pre-read)
Attendees: Alex (AE), Priya (CSM), request SE on call if needed: Ethan

Purpose:
- Prep for upcoming renewal discussion (target: June 2026)
- Surface technical blockers and ask list for SE to prioritize
- Align on success metrics we want to show to customer this quarter

Background / quick summary:
- AcmeCorp migrated to Redwood Hosted API Jan 2026. Onboarding looked good but last month saw increase in tail latency for long-context generation (seq len > 2k).
- Current monthly usage: ~1.2M tokens/day, steady week-over-week growth ~8%. Renewal value estimated $120k ARR (negotiation window May-June).
- Open support ticket JIRA-789 about intermittent 500s from region eu-west-1; customer sees ~0.5% error rate on peak window.
- Customer also asked about Private deployment options (on-prem) for compliance — early stage but worth surfacing to AE/Sales engineering.

Key metrics to have in meeting:
- Latency (p50/p95/p99) last 30 days, grouped by model and seq length
- Error rate trends (app & 5xx) last 14 days
- Token consumption + top 5 endpoints by volume
- Cost delta if move to Dedicated vs Hosted (rough TCO)

Talking points / agenda:
1) Quick wins (2-3 min) — thank Alex for escalations, whitelist the features customer liked
2) Tech health (5-7 min) — share p95/p99 trends; ask SE for root-cause hypotheses for tail latency
3) Prioritization of bugs (5 min) — confirm JIRA-789 owner and ETA for patch; propose temporary mitigations (route requests to alternate region / model fallback)
4) Renewal posture (8-10 min) — discuss usage growth, exec sponsors, pricing targets, potential concessions (SLA credits, reserved capacity trial)
5) Next steps & owners (2-3 min)

Open questions / notes to ask Alex:
- Who is exec sponsor at AcmeCorp? (I think it is Carla M., confirm contact and readiness for Exec review)
- Are there any contract constraints (procurement timeline, PO lead times) that push renewal earlier/later?
- Has Sales started an internal renewal playbook for this account? If yes, get copy.

Technical asks for SE (Ethan) to prepare if he joins:
- Check model routing logs for high-latency requests (time window: 2026-02-20 to 2026-03-03) and surface top causes
- Confirm whether KV cache is being used effectively for Acme workflows (they do a lot of prefix generation)
- Quick feasibility on private deployment timeline and minimum infra footprint for their workload (estimate GPUs, network reqs)

Proposed mitigations (short-term):
- Route high-latency requests to a fallback model variant (lower context or quantized) until we patch
- Enable additional logging on EU region for 2 weeks to capture repro
- Offer a 30-day Dedicated trial with limited SLA for them to test tail improvements (need pricing + SRE runbook)

Action items (with owners & target dates):
- Alex: confirm Exec sponsor name + procurement timeline; share contact by 2026-03-09
- Priya: prepare one-pager TCO (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with sample numbers for their current usage by 2026-03-11
- Ethan: investigate JIRA-789 root cause, share interim findings and mitigation options by 2026-03-09; if ETA > 1 week, propose route fallback config
- Alex + Priya: schedule joint Exec call (tentative week of 2026-03-22) if sponsor is available
- Priya: draft renewal playbook entry (key asks, leverage points, concessions table) by 2026-03-15

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this 1:1 focused — we don't need to deep-dive logs unless SE is on call.
- If we offer Dedicated trial, coordinate with Solutions Eng for a dry-run onboarding doc so trial is frictionless.
- Bring up Redwood Optimize recommendations as value-add in renewal (can help justify $ impact).

Follow-up template to send after the 1:1 (quick email):
Subject: Recap + next steps from today
Body bullets: 1) Quick thank you, 2) Confirmed owners & dates for each action, 3) Link to supporting artifacts (Confluence, Jira), 4) Proposed time for Exec call

References / links to pull into meeting:
- Confluence: AcmeCorp onboarding notes (confluence://pages/acmecorp-onboarding)
- Jira: JIRA-789 (errors), JIRA-790 (feature request: longer context support)
- Slack thread: #acct-acmecorp (slack://channels/C02ACME123)

Misc shorthand / reminders:
- If they push for >10% discount, push for term extension or reserved capacity commit.
- Watch for signals: exec engagement, security/compliance checklist requests -> these increase likelihood of Private conversation.

Next sync: propose 1:1 follow-up 2026-03-12 to review Ethan's findings and finalize TCO

End of notes.
